mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.0% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, thereby predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns as economic growth falters over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST < 590 and RSAFS < 350000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong residential construction, boosting consumer confidence and economic activity, thereby predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST is above 550.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 215 signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate labor market deterioration and manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both PAYEMS < 130000 and INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as economic growth stalls.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0.
